reference_sql:
WITH week_views AS (
  -- one row per page_view event of 7 to 13 December 2025 (Dublin days): only the page it shows
  SELECT list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'page_location')[1].value.string_value AS page_location
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251207' AND '20251213'
), paths AS (
  -- one row per page_view: its path, without the host and without any query string
  SELECT split_part(split_part(page_location, '?', 1), 'www.mailvora.example', 2) AS page
  FROM week_views
)
SELECT page, COUNT(*) AS views
FROM paths
GROUP BY page
alternatives:
SELECT regexp_extract([p.value.string_value FOR p IN event_params IF p.key = 'page_location'][1], '^https?://[^/]+([^?]*)', 1) AS page,
  COUNT(*) AS views
FROM events
WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '20251207' AND '20251213'
GROUP BY page

solver.query:
SELECT regexp_extract(list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'page_location')[1].value.string_value, '^https?://www\.mailvora\.example([^?]*)', 1) AS page, COUNT(*) AS views
